name: 96732 · Kahului, HI
findings: ZIP 96732 (Kahului) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96732 (Kahului) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 96732 (Kahului) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
